text: ]. Honest-verifier zero knowledge follows from [IMSX15, Section 6.1, Remark 6.10]. One can apply the guess-and-rewind simulator of [GMW91] to the honest-verifier simulator to obtain malicious-verifier zero knowledge; instantiating the vector commitment scheme with security parameter λ + O(log λ + log t) makes the error of this simulator at most 2−λ .
title: Proof step: zero knowledge via the guess-and-rewind simulator
